prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for sign_in reordering, home redesigns, finish layout changes, and choose_path copy (1 test each).
Evidence is still thin for adoption redesigns, home wait_info changes, sign_in copy updates, and choose_path redesigns (1 test each).
Predictions were too low for winning changes (adoption redesign and home wait_info).
Predictions were generally too high for changes that had no clear effect or performed worse.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: +9.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Changes:
0: [sign_in, copy] Sign-In Sync Reassurance Copy: Display clear text on the sign-in screen reassuring users that logging in saves and syncs their pet progress so pets are never lost upon re-login. (why: Support received 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing back in, making account persistence critical to explain upfront.)
1: [choose_path, redesign] Story Scroll Path Experience Redesign: Redesign the onboarding story intro into a story scroll layout to introduce pet options fluidly before path selection. (why: The choose_path step has a 76.2% conversion rate and a high mean duration of 514s, indicating users need a clearer, more engaging introduction.)
2: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Personality Trait Selection Screen: Insert a new screen called new_pet_traits right after pet selection where users pick key personality traits for their companion. (why: Adoption step conversion is 69.8% with median time 89s; giving users quick trait customization builds emotional attachment before adoption.)
3: [finish, redesign] Desktop Controls Overview Redesign: Redesign the home_intro finish screen into a two-column layout showing quick shortcuts for hiding, moving, and talking to the desktop pet. (why: Finish step conversion is 64.8% and support received multiple complaints from users confused about how to interact with or control their pet.)
4: [home, wait_info] Pet Preparation Status Carousel Tips: Display interactive tips on the waiting screen explaining companion behavior while the pet renders. (why: The waiting screen has a median duration of 201s (mean 2336s); keeping users entertained reduces drop-off during background generation.)
5: [sign_in, reorder] Sign-In Early Reordering Flow: Ensure sign-in immediately follows path selection before entering deep pet adoption steps. (why: Sign-in conversion is 72.9%; placing it cleanly after choose_path secures user state early before adoption tasks.)
6: [adoption, hint] Adoption Certificate Confirmation Hint: Add a hint to the adoption certificate screen guaranteeing that the pet certificate is created and saved automatically. (why: Adoption conversion is 69.8%, and users spend substantial time here; clear progress validation reduces hesitation before the waiting step.)
7: [home, notification] Pet Generation Desktop Ready Notification: Enable desktop notification prompts on the waiting screen to alert users when their pet is ready to join their desktop. (why: The waiting step mean time is high (2336s) and support receives tickets about pets missing when users switch focus while waiting.)
8: [finish, new_flow] First Pet Interaction Guided Screen: Add a new screen called new_first_interaction at the end of onboarding for a quick hands-on trial of pet controls. (why: Finish completion drops to 64.8% and support receives multiple messages regarding post-onboarding pet control confusion.)
